home.title:
Drag and drop,
engineered for Vue
home.lead: Sortable lists, kanban boards, trees, multi-drag and drop zones — animated, keyboard-ready and screen-reader friendly out of the box. Composables, not wrappers: your markup, your styles.

visual.hint: Drag the tiles — or Tab to one and press Space

features.title:
Everything drag and drop needs.
Nothing it doesn't.
features.description: One provider, a handful of composables, and the hard parts handled: geometry, animation, accessibility, edge cases.

items.title: Sortable lists and grids
items.text: Vertical, horizontal and grid layouts with live reordering. Render the draft, the library writes the drop.

items.title: Kanban boards
items.text: Lists in one group exchange items. Copy from palettes, take plain draggables in, swap instead of shifting.

items.title: Trees
items.text: Nest by dragging sideways or by hovering a row. Depth limits, nesting rules, collapsed branches.

items.title: Multi-drag
items.text: Ctrl-click or a rubber band selects; the whole block travels together and lands in order.

items.title: Animated by default
items.text: FLIP while sorting, a drop that lands on its slot, data changes that animate. Bring GSAP or motion if you like.

items.title: Accessible
items.text: Keyboard drags by slots, live announcements, ARIA attributes that never override yours.

items.title: Virtual lists
items.text: Works with TanStack Virtual and VueUse: thousands of rows, still animated, still sortable.

items.title: Controlled mode
items.text: Pinia, a server, immutable data: prevent the default write and apply the result yourself.

items.title: DevTools
items.text: A live mini-map, a joystick that drags anything, options you can edit while the app runs.

ecosystem.title: One core, a few focused packages
ecosystem.core: The provider, composables, sensors, modifiers and animations.
ecosystem.actions: Programmatic drags: “move up” buttons, menus, tours, tests.
ecosystem.devtools: A tab in Vue DevTools and Nuxt DevTools with a live mini-map.
ecosystem.nuxt: Auto-imports, global components and SSR-safe defaults.
ecosystem.skill: An agent skill: AI assistants learn how the library works.
